overloads.semanticRole: The SOAP SEND FAULT command returns an error to a SOAP client indicating the origin of the fault: client or server.

constraints: faultType selects the origin of the error reported to the SOAP client: 1 = client fault (e.g. an invalid request), 2 = server fault (e.g. a server-side resource error).
Using this command lets the Web Service method report an error to the client without returning a normal result.
